data.name: ICON Duplo Ribeira
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Accommodation
ICON Duplo Ribeira, a 4-star hotel in the heart of Porto, offers air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi and private bathrooms. Some rooms even feature balconies with stunning city views.

Convenient Amenities
Guests can enjoy room service, a 24-hour front desk, and tour assistance. The hotel provides safety deposit boxes, desk space, and flat-screen TVs in all rooms, ensuring a comfortable stay.

Delicious Dining Options
Start your day with a delicious breakfast offering buffet, continental, or Full English/Irish options. Located near popular attractions like Ribeira Square and Sao Bento Train Station, ICON Duplo Ribeira is the perfect choice for your Porto getaway.
